hooks.text: The first human craft on Mars carried skis.
The first craft to reach Mars arrived as wreckage.
Humanity reached Mars 25 years before NASA's first rover.

title: The First Craft on Mars Carried Skis
description: In 1971, Soviet spacecraft Mars 2 became the first human-made object to reach Mars, carrying a miniature rover built to waddle on skis.

beats.text: The first human craft on Mars carried skis.
beats.visual: replica model of the PrOP-M ski rover, Memorial Museum of Cosmonautics

beats.text: Its tiny robotic rover was designed to waddle on a tether.
beats.visual: schematic diagram of the Soviet PrOP-M rover and descent module, 1971

beats.text: Soviet probe Mars 2 arrived in 1971 during a planet-wide dust storm.
beats.visual: Mariner 9 global view of the 1971 planet-wide Martian dust storm

beats.text: The lander slammed into the Martian atmosphere at six kilometers per second.
beats.visual: diagram of Soviet Mars lander atmospheric entry trajectory and descent capsule, 1971

beats.text: Blinded by the raging dust, the descent sequence failed completely.
beats.visual: telescopic view of dust clouds shrouding the Martian surface, 1971

beats.text: The craft smashed into the dirt, destroying the rover on impact.
beats.visual: high-resolution satellite view of the Martian surface in Hellas Planitia, HiRISE

beats.text: Yet that violent crash made it the first human object on Mars.
beats.visual: Soviet commemorative pennant with USSR state emblem carried aboard Mars 2, 1971
subjects: State Emblem of the Soviet Union
queries: State Emblem of the Soviet Union

beats.text: Nothing made by human hands had ever reached Mars.
beats.visual: Viking orbiter color global mosaic of the planet Mars

better_than_last: Eliminates terminal dangling phrasing with a grammatically complete echo beat that circles directly back into the opening hook.
